Case reference: 2014005576.CaseDesc: Daniel Dumigan's family lost contact with him in July of 1975. They received information that he was planning to leave for Vancouver, BC.

Case reference: 2024031130.CaseDesc: On June 16, 2024, Mark Bullock was last seen in Jasper, Alberta.  Mark was reported to be traveling to Jasper with a friend.

Case reference: 2014002850.CaseDesc: On May 21, 1997, Ardavan TAHERZADEH last communicated with his parents while he was backpacking in India, indicating that he wished to explore more of the country. Ardavan was a University of British Columbia student who took a year off to teach English as a second language in Korea and travel extensively in Northern India.  His last call was from Koshla, Kullu Province in India. On June 28, 1997, Ardavan was reported missing to the West Vancouver Police Department by family after he missed his flight home on June 25, 1997. We have not received any communication from Ardavan since.

Case reference: 2013000095.CaseDesc: On October 19, 1969, Ronald Bonkowski went fishing with two friends on the Winnipeg River, on the outskirts of Pointe du Bois in Manitoba. Upon reaching their desired location, they anchored their boat in fast-moving water. However, the anchor became ensnared in the riverbed, causing the boat to capsize. All three men were thrown into the water. Two of the men were able to swim to the shore, but Ronald was seen to go under the water. Searches were conducted by water and on land, but he was never found. It is presumed that he drowned.

Case reference: 2006024099.CaseDesc: David Jennings was last seen on June 13, 1991. He is presumed to have drowned on Blackstone Lake in Archipelago Township.

Jacket: Silk, Blue, across shoulders "Bass Fishing"  picture bass fish

Case reference: 2022058884.CaseDesc: Donna Williams, last seen in Red Deer, Alberta on November 18, 2022 at the Women's Shelter. Donna leads a high-risk lifestyle, is frequently in transit, and has been known to travel between the provinces of Alberta and British Columbia. Further information indicates that Donna may have been known to furnish social care facilities and businesses with fraudulent identification documents and contact information.

Case reference: 2014003840.CaseDesc: On December 7, 1986, a male was seen floating in the river. The identity of the male was unknown to police until Roderick Cook's parents contacted police advising they had not seen their son for some time. It is assumed the man in the river was Roderick based both on the description and the fact that he was seen walking near the river. Police further found footprints that led from the shore to the open water. No foul play is suspected in this matter and it is assumed Roderick drowned.

He had signs of having suffered an acute or chronic right lung infection. He is estimated to have been dead for several months. Biogeographic Ancestry testing predicts this unidentified male is either of European ancestry, or South Asian ancestry, or mixed European and South Asian ancestry.

Case reference: 2014006315.CaseDesc: Julia Strobach was last seen in her residence on Braidwood Road in Courtenay, British Columbia on October 31st, 2013 in the early evening hours.  Unfortunately, after a lengthy and comprehensive investigation police have been unable to find any trace of Julia.  Police along with Julia’s friends and family are gravely concerned for Julia's wellbeing as she has been out of contact for a year now.  It is completely out of character for Julia to be out of contact with her friends and family for so long, especially with her 3 year old son.  Julia’s red bicycle with yellow seat was also missing. Police are appealing to anyone with information about Julia's movements and activities in the days and weeks leading up to October 31st, 2013, to get in touch with investigators immediately.

Case reference: 2008005999.CaseDesc: On September 8, 1978, Brian McLean and his co-worker, Russell Thomas, were commercial fishing at their camp on MacDowell Lake, near MacDowell Lake First Nation Territory. He then realized that Brian was not there. Russell headed back towards the camp and found Brian's boat washed up against the shore approximately three or four hundred metres from the camp. The motor was in forward gear with the throttle off, and the paddle was missing from the boat. MacDowell Lake is 90 "air miles" north of Red Lake, and is accessible only by air. The area was searched, and the lake was dragged, but Brian McLean has not been found.

On August 1, 1970, Arthur's vehicle was located near Falcon Beach.  Extensive ground, lake and air searches were done of the area. All efforts to locate him failed to uncover any further leads.
